eschatology.title: Shaul Shaked, "Eschatology i. In Zoroastrianism and Zoroastrian Influence," Encyclopaedia Iranica
eschatology.scope: Scholarly overview; distinguishes Avestan and later evidence and argues for Iranian influence while acknowledging disagreement. Not a collation of original manuscripts.

scrolls.title: Jacques Duchesne-Guillemin, "Dead Sea Scrolls," Encyclopaedia Iranica
scrolls.scope: Historical argument for Iranian parallels in the two-spirits teaching. Its particular transmission reconstruction is an argument, not an established consensus.

ezekiel.title: Ezekiel 37:1-14, New American Bible Revised Edition, USCCB
ezekiel.scope: Primary passage in translation, with clearly separate editorial notes. The passage identifies the bones with Israel.

daniel.title: Daniel 12:1-3, New American Bible Revised Edition, USCCB
daniel.scope: Primary passage in translation. The text speaks of many awakening; this does not establish universal agreement among ancient Jews.

job.title: Job 2:1-10, New American Bible Revised Edition, USCCB
job.scope: Primary passage in translation; the accuser acts with permission and within a limit.

guide.title: Maimonides, Guide for the Perplexed III.22, translated by M. Friedlander
guide.scope: Primary philosophical text in an older English translation. Its interpretation of Job is not itself evidence about the ancient book's original composition.

kings11.title: Maimonides, Mishneh Torah, Laws of Kings and Wars 11, translated by Eliyahu Touger
kings11.scope: Primary legal text in translation; 11:3 addresses miracles, and 11:4 gives messianic criteria and its criticism of Christianity. Translator notes are not Maimonides' own words.

kings12.title: Maimonides, Mishneh Torah, Laws of Kings and Wars 12, translated by Eliyahu Touger
kings12.scope: Primary legal text in translation; 12:1 treats natural order, 12:2 uncertain scenarios, and 12:4-5 the purpose of the messianic age.

principles.title: The Thirteen Principles of Jewish Faith, Chabad presentation of Maimonides' Perek Chelek introduction
principles.scope: A concise traditional presentation, not an independently collated translation of the complete Judeo-Arabic introduction.

stanford.title: Kenneth Seeskin, "Maimonides," Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
stanford.scope: Scholarly philosophical overview, including the resurrection controversy and Maimonides' intellectual context. It is not a survey ranking every modern Orthodox authority.

patach.title: Patach Eliyahu, Tikkunei Zohar introduction 17a, translated and annotated by Avraham Sutton
patach.scope: A Kabbalistic primary passage in annotated translation. Bracketed explanations belong to the translator; traditional authorship claims are not used here as independently verified dates.

yazidis.title: Christine Allison, "Yazidis i. General," Encyclopaedia Iranica
yazidis.scope: Historical discussion of oral tradition and the disputed printed sacred books. Its older demographic figures are not reused as current statistics.

mandaeans.title: Edmondo Lupieri, "Mandaeans i. History," Encyclopaedia Iranica
mandaeans.scope: Scholarly account that discusses contested origins and textual transmission. It does not settle every Mandaean community's self-understanding.

mark.title: Mark 12:18-27, King James Version, Bible Gateway
mark.scope: Primary Gospel passage in translation. It supports a claim about the narrative portrayal of Jesus, not automatic access to the exact words of the historical Jesus.
